component.name: DonutCleaner
component.summary: Clean caches and remove unused packages

description.p: DonutCleaner shows how much space your caches and installed software take up and lets you remove what you no longer need. It draws installed packages and their dependencies as a graph, warns before you remove something other packages rely on, and scans for reclaimable space such as package caches, orphaned packages, build caches, coredumps and the systemd journal.
System package cleanup currently supports Arch-based systems. On other distributions, Flatpak, AppImage, Cargo, npm and pip cleanup still work.
Root actions now go through a separate helper with its own polkit action. The helper accepts seven fixed operations and checks every path and package name.
First release as DonutCleaner, formerly SysClean. Cleanup commands now pass each path as its own argument.
